acceptance_tests.target-completeness: Prove the full error theorem for arbitrary real functions f, D and real x, h, L satisfying the stated hypotheses.
acceptance_tests.derivative-hypotheses: Use continuity on the closed interval and actual derivative D(t) on the open interval.
acceptance_tests.variation-hypothesis: Use the pointwise absolute variation bound relative to D(x) on the open interval.
acceptance_tests.conclusion-linkage: Prove an absolute error at most L*h between the defined forward difference and D(x).
acceptance_tests.assumption-integrity: Use only the specified hypotheses, including h > 0 and L >= 0, without requiring derivatives at endpoints or global smoothness.

review_policy: Require formal verification and agreeing automated semantic passes. Expert review remains pending.
